sources.title: Morita Equivalence
sources.publication: arXiv2015 manuscript; Review of Symbolic Logic2016
sources.read_scope: Primary fulltext read: section2 many-sorted syntax/semantics, Theorem3.1 unique definitional expansion, section4.1 product/coproduct/subsort/quotient definitions, Theorem4.1 Morita expansion up to isomorphism and associated proof.
sources.parent_result: Definitional and Morita extensions permit semantically conservative reformulations; new product sorts and projections explain why symbol/sort counts are not invariant measures of information.
sources.adaptation: Unique two-sided unit gives an explicit definable identity operation. Pair packing retains both process and objective information in one field. V9's recoverability invariance requires a specified commuting observable diagram.
sources.limits: No identification of categorical equivalence, Morita equivalence and bijective observable coding. No formalization of the entire paper in Lean. Lean's possibly empty types differ from the paper's nonempty-sort convention, so empty-image cases are handled explicitly.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, Section4.2: Definitions
sources.read_scope: Current primary maintained definitions of categories, functors and subcategories, including identities and agreement of source/target/composition.
sources.parent_result: Typed associative composition and unit axioms; subcategories retain ambient identity and composition structure.
sources.adaptation: Two-object parallel-arrow category has exactly four wide subcategories. Unit uniqueness is proved directly and separately from unit existence.
sources.limits: Category theory is the declared process model, not a theorem that every conceivable intelligence formalism has this signature.

claim_boundary: Only the declared model class, ambient domain and observation-preserving translations. Semantic nonrecoverability is not statistical independence, metaphysical autonomy, a universal minimal signature or all-family intelligence derivation.
